captions.detailed: A compact, box-style desk fan featuring a white plastic main frame with black corner accents. It has a central five-blade rotor in dark grey, protected by front and back circular safety grilles. A cylindrical dark grey speed control knob is mounted on the side face of the frame. The internal fan blades can spin continuously on a central revolute joint, and the side knob can rotate to select speed settings.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact desk box fan in white plastic. The model must include a main box frame with corner accents, front and rear safety grilles, a dark grey five-blade rotor on a continuous revolute joint, and a three-position speed control knob on the right side.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using an ArticulatedObject. The base frame is built as a white box with cutouts, complete with black corner accents and bottom support feet. The front and rear safety grilles are modeled using concentric cylinders and radial spokes. The rotor is built with a central cylindrical hub and five angled rectangular blades. A separate cylindrical knob is created for the speed control on the side. Revolute joints are defined for both the main rotor assembly and the control knob to allow rotation.
